title: Rejection on a Blank Input Symbol
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over Booleans and let $y$ be a Boolean input word. Suppose that, for every work-tape contents function, the constructed transition rule in state $st$ on a blank input symbol is the rejecting action. Let $p$ satisfy $1\le p\le |y|+1$, and suppose the symbol at zero-based position $p-1$ is absent. For any three auxiliary words, one step from the corresponding configuration has no successor state and has output exactly the one-bit word $[\mathrm{false}]$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over Booleans
For every work-tape contents function, the transition rule in state $st$ on blank input is the rejecting action
The symbol at position $p-1$ is absent
